description.en: Chromium web browser for Nintendo Switch running under Linux Kernel Library (LKL). Direct browser startup with no intermediate launcher.
description.tr: Linux Kernel Library (LKL) üzerinde çalışan Nintendo Switch için Chromium web tarayıcısı. Ara başlatıcı olmadan doğrudan tarayıcı açılışı.
description.de: Chromium-Webbrowser für Nintendo Switch auf Basis der Linux Kernel Library (LKL). Direktstart ohne Launcher.
description.es: Navegador web Chromium para Nintendo Switch sobre Linux Kernel Library (LKL). Inicio directo sin lanzador.
description.fr: Navigateur web Chromium pour Nintendo Switch basé sur Linux Kernel Library (LKL). Démarrage direct sans lanceur.
description.ja: Linux Kernel Library（LKL）上で動作するNintendo Switch用Chromiumウェブブラウザ。ランチャーなしのダイレクト起動。
description.ko: Linux Kernel Library(LKL) 기반 Nintendo Switch용 Chromium 웹 브라우저. 런처 없는 다이렉트 실행 지원.
description.zh: 基于 Linux Kernel Library (LKL) 的任天堂 Switch 版 Chromium 网页浏览器，支持跳过启动器直接运行。

author: shodowlo, Chromium Authors, Port by sonerx7
